description: Get a download link for the household's Schedule H, for a tax year that has ended. Returns download_url, a link on nannykeeper.com that works for 15 minutes: give it to the user and tell them to open it in their browser to download the PDF. This tool never returns the PDF itself, and you must not open the link yourself. When the dashboard would not produce the form this answers schedule_h_unavailable with a reason (for example year_not_ended, or a question the family still has to answer in the dashboard); report that reason faithfully. NannyKeeper does not file the form. For a household other than the key's own, pass its employer_id.

employer_id.description: Optional. Leave it out to use the household your API key belongs to. Pass it only when one account manages several households; list_employees returns it.

tax_year.description: A tax year that has ended, for example 2025.

name: get_schedule_h
